name: Optional independent recovery supervisor
statement: Where platform permits and user explicitly opts in, a separately governed lightweight supervisor may use OS session, startup and resume signals to check and restore a failing companion without needing the browser extension to be open.
requiredProperties: no fake execution while asleep or powered off
least privilege and bounded wake policy
not mandatory for normal client operation

provenance.sourceReference: Owner companion recovery design 2026-10-15; Chute Windows v2.6.1 RC1 historical reference
